agents.reinstatement_reason: Retired 2026-05-14 for 14 cycles without an APPROVED pick. The firm-wide buy freeze (CRO risk-calc bug: VaR/Herfindahl weighted by signed net exposure, ~87x inflation) was already ~194 days old at that point, so no agent could earn an approved pick regardless of research quality. The CRO exoneration that freezes the zero-pick counter during such a freeze was added 2026-06-09 -- 26 days too late for this agent. The 'role reassignment at cycle 9' cited in the retirement reason was a no-op: reassigned_to has no reader, sector never changed, and the promised performance reset never happened (the counter ran 9 -> 14). The 'fresh specialist' spawned into this slot was the same class, same file, same sector, same ETF. Reinstated 2026-07-31 by Co-Chairman decision.
